source.quote: Constellation Brands reported net sales of $2.43 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) of $3.43
The filing reported operating cash flow of $661.8 million and free cash flow of $484.6 million
STZ's board announced a quarterly dividend of $1.03 per share for Class A shares on June 30, 2026
It repurchased $324 million of shares year to date through June 2026
STZ plans to incur capital expenditures of $800 million in fiscal 2027
It expects free cash flow of $1.6-$1.7 billion
